howTo.title: How to book
howTo.stepOneText: Enter your contact details and the number of people in each age group.
howTo.stepTwoText: If payment is due, send the amount shown with your booking code in the message. Free bookings are confirmed immediately.
howTo.stepThreeText: Right away, or later with the link sent by email. You are notified as soon as your seat is confirmed.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: A few answers to help you book with confidence.
faq.paymentQuestion: How do I pay for my booking?
faq.paymentAnswer: Pay by Interac e-Transfer. The amount, recipient and booking code to include in the transfer message are shown after you book.
faq.proofQuestion: How do I send my proof of payment?
faq.proofAnswer: Keep your personal booking link to send a screenshot of your transfer, right away or later.
faq.refundAnswer: No refunds once the transfer is sent.
